summary: This bill requires that certain aspects of bridge construction, repair, and maintenance projects receiving federal funds, including those involving corrosion prevention and coating applications, be carried out by third-party certified contractors who employ individuals trained and certified by qualified programs, and it also mandates a study on best practices for inspecting and addressing corrosion on weathering steel bridges.

scores.thoughts: The bill expands the eligibility for federal grant funding to include corrosion control work on rail bridges, which would lead to increased government spending in this area. It also mandates a study by the Secretary of Transportation, which incurs costs.
